relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed significant elevations in lysophospholipids with 18:1 fatty acid chain, especially lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) and lysophosphatidylglycerol (LPG) after paclitaxel treatment.

relationships.subject: unsaturated lysophospholipids
relationships.evidence_quote: these unsaturated lysophospholipids, but not their saturated counterparts, activated the transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) channel

key_findings: Paclitaxel raised plasma 18:1 lysophospholipids (LPC, LPG) in patients, and these activated TRPV1 on sensory neurons.
LPG binds the TRPV1 vanilloid pocket with potency dependent on proximity to Y511.
